title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 24
subtitle: I Feel Super!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 24: I Feel Super! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi! I see you like superhero culture. Me too.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我看你喜欢超级英雄文化。我也是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In fact, tonight I’m going to the big superhero convention. Are you going?
dialogue.zh: 其实今晚我要去超级英雄大会。你去吗？

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Um, I don’t know.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我不知道。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, you'd better decide soon. Last year, it sold out.
dialogue.zh: 那你最好快点决定。去年票卖光了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, since we’re talking about superheroes: would you rather become a superhero by accident, like Spiderman, or be born a superhero, like Wonder Woman?
dialogue.zh: 既然我们在谈超级英雄：你更愿意像蜘蛛侠那样意外成为超级英雄，还是像神奇女侠那样生来就是？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Take your time. It’s a big question. I thought about it for days –
dialogue.zh: 慢慢想。这是个大问题。我想了好几天——

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Okay. If I had to choose, I’d rather be born a superhero.
dialogue.zh: 好。如果必须选，我更愿意生来就是超级英雄。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’d rather become a superhero by an unexpected accident!
dialogue.zh: 我更愿意因为一场意外事故成为超级英雄！

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Aren’t all accidents unexpected?
dialogue.zh: 事故不都是意外的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, yeah.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，对。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: What was that!? Are you okay?
dialogue.zh: 那是什么？！你没事吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm better than okay. I feel super!
dialogue.zh: 我岂止没事。我感觉超棒！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Oh no! Anna was just hit by lightning. She had better get help. We use had better to give advice. It is very informal and stronger than should and ought to. For example, Anna says: “You'd better decide soon. Last year, it sold out.” When we use had better, we usually shorten the word had for personal pronouns. We use would rather to say what we or someone else prefers to do or have. For example, the boy says: “Okay. If I had to choose, I’d rather be born a superhero.” With would rather, we also shorten the word would when used with personal pronouns. Keep watching and listen for had better and would rather.
dialogue.zh: 哦不！安娜刚被闪电击中。她最好去求助。had better 用来给建议，很口语，比 should 和 ought to 更强。比如安娜说：“You'd better decide soon. Last year, it sold out.” 用 had better 时，人称代词后的 had 通常缩写。would rather 用来表示自己或别人更想做什么或要什么。比如那个男孩说：“Okay. If I had to choose, I’d rather be born a superhero.” 用 would rather 时，人称代词后的 would 也常缩写。继续看，注意听 had better 和 would rather。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: You’d better see a doctor.
dialogue.zh: 你最好去看医生。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’ve never felt better!
dialogue.zh: 我从来没这么好过！

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: You were just struck by lightning!! And what happened to your hair and your clothes?
dialogue.zh: 你刚被闪电击中了！！你的头发和衣服怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't know. Wait, I do know. This is my super suit! And this is my origin story.
dialogue.zh: 我不知道。等等，我知道了。这是我的超级战衣！这也是我的起源故事。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: What are you talking about?
dialogue.zh: 你在说什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: An origin story tells the beginning of a superhero. You should know that.
dialogue.zh: 起源故事讲的是超级英雄的开始。这你该知道。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: You're not making any sense, lady.
dialogue.zh: 女士，你说的完全没道理。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I would rather be called Lightning Bolt Lady! It’ll sound great in a theme song: Lightning Bolt Lady!
dialogue.zh: 我更愿意叫闪电女士！主题曲里会很好听：闪电女士！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now, I need to find my superpowers --
dialogue.zh: 现在，我得找到我的超能力——

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Um, I really think --
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我真的觉得——

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wait. Don’t tell me. I’ll read your mind. You are thinking you’d like to be my super helper.
dialogue.zh: 等等。别告诉我。我来读你的心。你在想你想当我的超级助手。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: I was not thinking that.
dialogue.zh: 我没那么想。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: ... that you’d like to live in a treehouse.
dialogue.zh: ……你想住在树屋里。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: … that you should eat more vegetables.
dialogue.zh: ……你该多吃蔬菜。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Please, stop talking. You really should get some help.
dialogue.zh: 请你别说了。你真的该去求助。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Mind reading is not my superpower. Maybe I can become invisible. I … am … invisible!
dialogue.zh: 读心不是我的超能力。也许我能隐身。我……隐……身了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You can’t see me. Who am I? I’m not here. You can’t see me.
dialogue.zh: 你看不见我。我是谁？我不在这儿。你看不见我。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: I can see you and so can everybody else.
dialogue.zh: 我看得见你，别人也看得见。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No power of invisibility. Maybe I can create a force field. I feel it working. Nothing can hurt –
dialogue.zh: 没有隐身能力。也许我能制造力场。我感觉它在起作用。什么都伤不了——

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ow, that wasn’t very nice. I see I have a lot of work to do. Well, goodbye, non-super person!
dialogue.zh: 哎哟，那可不太友好。看来我还有很多要练。好了，再见，非超级人！

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Wait. I’d better go with you. You might get worse…if that’s even possible.
dialogue.zh: 等等。我最好跟你一起去。你可能会更糟……如果还能更糟的话。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That's very nice of you, ordinary human. But I’d rather go by myself. This is a quest.
dialogue.zh: 你真好，普通人类。可我更愿意自己去。这是一次任务。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Every time you speak, I get more confused.
dialogue.zh: 你每说一句，我就更糊涂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A quest is a part of all superhero stories. You really need to work on your superhero studies. Now, stand back. I’ve never flown before.
dialogue.zh: 任务是所有超级英雄故事的一部分。你真该补补超级英雄课。现在，退后。我以前从没飞过。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: And you’re not flying now.
dialogue.zh: 你现在也没在飞。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Flying is also not my superpower. That’s too bad. It's going to be expensive to Uber everywhere. You know, I'd rather walk. It’s a nice day. Goodbye, non-super person.
dialogue.zh: 飞也不是我的超能力。太可惜了。到处打车会很贵。你知道吗，我宁愿走路。今天天气不错。再见，非超级人。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: I am not talking to strangers again.
dialogue.zh: 我再也不跟陌生人说话了。

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: Will Lightning Bolt Lady find her superpowers … ever? Ouch! Did that brick wall hurt? Will the young man ever talk to a stranger again? Find out on the next episode of Let’s Learn English!
dialogue.zh: 闪电女士到底……找不找得到她的超能力？哎哟！那面砖墙疼不疼？那个年轻人还会再跟陌生人说话吗？请看下集 Let’s Learn English！

quiz.prompt: What happens to Anna while she is talking about superheroes?
What name does Anna want to be called?
Which superpower does Anna actually have in this lesson?
choices: None of the ones she tries
